INVENTED CASE SUMMARIES — FOR TESTING THE CASE DATABASE UPLOAD ONLY.
None of these cases is real: the names, citations and facts are made up. Do not use them for an estimate.
Download a Microsoft Word version
## Recklessly causing serious injury
Case name: R v Alder (invented) [2021] VSCA 9001
Head Sentence / Orders: 4 years imprisonment, NPP 2 years
Offences: RCSI – 3 years 6 months; affray – 6 months
Plea: G (early)
Offender: 24y male
Facts: At a crowded hotel the offender, who had been drinking, swung a glass at a patron after an argument. The glass broke and cut the victim's face, leaving a permanent scar. No prior convictions; remorse; good prospects.
Case name: DPP v Birch (invented) [2022] VSCA 9002
Head Sentence / Orders: 6 years imprisonment, NPP 4 years
Offences: RCSI – 5 years
Plea: G
Offender: 31y male
Facts: Outside a nightclub the offender struck the victim with a bottle, fracturing his skull. Relevant prior convictions for violence; on a community correction order at the time.
Case name: R v Cedar (invented) [2020] VCC 9003
Head Sentence / Orders: CCO 2 years with 200 hours unpaid community work
Offences: RCSI
Plea: G (early)
Offender: 19y male
Facts: A young offender pushed the victim during a fight at a party; the victim fell and broke an arm. Youth, no priors and strong rehabilitation prospects.
Case name: DPP v Dune (invented) [2023] VCC 9004
Head Sentence / Orders: 3 years imprisonment, NPP 18 months
Offences: RCSI – 3 years
Plea: NG
Offender: 40y female
Facts: The offender threw a heavy ashtray during a domestic argument, causing a serious eye injury. Found guilty at trial.
## Intentionally causing serious injury
Case name: DPP v Elm (invented) [2021] VSCA 9005
Head Sentence / Orders: 8 years imprisonment, NPP 5 years 6 months
Offences: ICSI – 7 years
Plea: G
Offender: 28y male
Facts: The offender stabbed the victim in the abdomen during a dispute over a debt. Planned; weapon carried to the scene.
Case name: R v Fir (invented) [2019] VCC 9006
Head Sentence / Orders: 5 years imprisonment, NPP 3 years
Offences: ICSI – 5 years
Plea: G (late)
Offender: 35y male
Facts: Repeated punches and kicks to a man on the ground outside a bar, causing facial fractures and a brain injury.
## Intentionally causing injury
Case name: DPP v Gum (invented) [2022] VCC 9007
Head Sentence / Orders: CCO 18 months
Offences: ICI
Plea: G (early)
Offender: 22y female
Facts: A single punch to the face in a car park; the victim's nose was broken. No priors.
Case name: R v Hazel (invented) [2018] VCC 9008
Head Sentence / Orders: 12 months imprisonment
Offences: ICI – 12 months
Plea: G
Offender: 45y male
Facts: The offender headbutted a security guard who refused him entry, causing cuts and bruising. Lengthy history of violence.
## Recklessly causing injury
Case name: DPP v Ivy (invented) [2023] VCC 9009
Head Sentence / Orders: CCO 12 months with 100 hours unpaid community work
Offences: RCI
Plea: G (early)
Offender: 27y male
Facts: During horseplay that turned into a scuffle the offender shoved the victim into a table, causing bruising and a cut.
## Armed robbery
Case name: R v Juniper (invented) [2021] VSCA 9010
Head Sentence / Orders: 7 years imprisonment, NPP 4 years
Offences: Armed robbery – 5 years; RCSI – 3 years
Plea: G
Offender: 30y male
Facts: The offender robbed a service station with a knife and slashed the attendant's arm while escaping.
## Burglary
Case name: DPP v Kauri (invented) [2020] VCC 9011
Head Sentence / Orders: 2 years imprisonment
Offences: Burglary – 2 years
Plea: G
Offender: 33y male
Facts: Night-time burglary of a house while the occupants were away; property worth $4000 taken.
